I've written the LRU cache simulator in Go, and all 5 example cases pass under `node check.mjs`. `go vet` and the unit tests are also clean.

- **Structure:** the cache lives in `internal/lru`. Entries sit in a doubly linked list stored in a slice and found through a map, so every command runs in O(1) expected time. Removed entries are reused, so the list never grows past the capacity. `main.go` reads commands and writes the output.
- **Speed:** I generated a 1,000,000-command input with capacit
